customManagers.description: Scanner tool versions pinned via '# renovate:' comments in the backend Dockerfile

packageRules.description: These release tags use a 'v' prefix but the Dockerfile ARG stores the bare version

prBodyNotes: **depx is checksum-pinned:** update the amd64/arm64 `checksum=` values in the depx stage of `noovastack-vapt/backend/Dockerfile` from the release's checksums file, or the build will fail.

packageRules.description: Bundle minor/patch scanner updates into one weekly PR
Major scanner updates get their own PR and can change CLI flags or output format

prBodyNotes:
### Scanner update review checklist
- [ ] Read the upstream release notes linked above (look for changed CLI flags, output/JSON format, removed options, new network behaviour)
- [ ] `scanner-tools` CI check is green and the version table in the PR comment shows the expected versions
- [ ] If CLI flags changed: `_external_tool_command` in `backend/workers/tasks_scan.py` still builds a valid command
- [ ] If output format changed: `_ingest_tool_findings` in `backend/workers/tasks_scan.py` still parses it
- [ ] Ran a quick/standard scan against a lab target with the rebuilt image and findings look right
- [ ] Tool is still non-destructive by default (`safe_default` in `backend/scans/tools.py` unchanged or re-reviewed)
